Happy release day everyone!

After 5 years of development and countless hours of work Love & Sex: Second Base is finally getting out of Early Access on Steam!
What I started for fun while I was bored after surgery became a game enjoyed by thousands of players across the world.
It grew from a hobby to my full time job, from a solo project to a 4 man studio and allowed us to release several other titles in the mean time.
And none of this would have been possible without you, our supporters, our community, who believed in this before everyone else and decided to help me make that crazy idea a reality.

Because yes it's a pretty crazy game...
Here are a few numbers to remind us of the road traveled:
- 440+ full screen artworks
- 20+ love interests
- 1000+ events
- 14 000+ voiced lines
- 13+ polyamorous relationships

I'll say it again for those in the back, L&S is the biggest fattest hand drawn dating sim out there, I have seen players well over 500 hours of playtime on Steam.
Even with that much content we did not compromise on quality as the game stands currently at a Very Positive rating with 93% good review on Steam!

Sure, we still have some little stuff to polish here and there but the game is mostly complete with close to 50 endings. And we are not done yet, we still have the female side of the game to complete, plans for a year of additional content for Mike and at least one DLC with 3 new waifus coming up next year.

Beyond Love & Sex we released TruLove and Leap of Love both projects I am pretty proud of, each time we improved our workflow and the end result. We also have My Demonic Romance poking it's horned head around the corner, and you should definitely have a peek.

Yeah I am crazy proud of what we did together during those 5 years, so thank you for believing in us, thank you for following us and thank you for playing our little games :D

notes.title: Leap of Love teaser #1
notes.content:
Hi guys :)

For our first teaser I decided to talk to you about the Map and Attributes system in Leap of Love.

MAP
The game world is represented by a map of a fantasy town and the lands surounding it. in the morning you can choose one of those locations to train in and in the afternoon if an event is available you can go to the corresponding location (otherwise you get a random event).
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/37044432/79dac3780cca628cff455ef283da0ff6aab669dc.jpg

ATTRIBUTES
To survive and seduce his beloved our hero, Kaheroux, will need to train and better himself in three areas of expertise or Attributes.

Prowess is a mesure of Kaheroux's might and will be useful to overpower opponents during events or win duels. It can be improved by training with the castle's guards.
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/37044432/d342495b1157216c42cc65c032aaee69c82f169f.jpg

Knowledge represents Kaheroux's smarts and wisdom, with it he will be able to better understands the plots of his enemies and foil them. You'll need to spend time in the library to improve it.
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/37044432/b130415cb6ad0d6525db7e9db87f3cc6cb6e14c7.jpg

Finally Charm is Kaheroux's good looks and mastery of the words, in a game of seduction this can only be an important matter right... You'll be able to train yourself in it at the market.
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/37044432/34e417dc8ab75952e47af752ceebc13cd39b0464.jpg

The three atrributes system make up the core of the gameplay in Leap of Love, by carefully planning your training you'll be able to navigate through the dangerous life of a prince and maybe marry your chosen bride.

You can wishlist Leap of Love on Steam, it should be released on Steam on the 1st of January.
